com.vector.cfg.gen.core.genusage.groovy.api.swct

Interface IGenerationSwctSettingsApi


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
 @PublishedFilter(value=MsrPlatform.class)
 @NotThreadSafe
public interface IGenerationSwctSettingsApi
    The class IGenerationSwctSettingsApi encapsulates all settings which belong to a Swct generation process.
    Examples:
    • Select the software components to execute
    • Retrieve the available software components

    All method parameters and return values must be non-null unless documented otherwise.

      • softwareComponentByAsrPath

        @PublishedMethod
ISwctComponentUsage softwareComponentByAsrPath(AsrPath componentPath)
        Searches the component by name, and the first match is returned.

        The ISwctComponentUsage.getAsrPath() is tested against the componentPath. If nothing found, an GeneratorNotFoundException is thrown.

        Parameters:
        componentName - the component name
        Returns:
        the found component
        Throws:
        GeneratorNotFoundException - If no associated component could be found for the passed componentName.

      • softwareComponentByName

        @PublishedMethod
ISwctComponentUsage softwareComponentByName(java.lang.String componentName)
        Searches the component by name, and the first match is returned.

        First the ISwctComponentUsage.getName() is tested. If nothing is found the componentName is converted to an AsrPath, and the tested against ISwctComponentUsage.getAsrPath(). If still nothing found, an GeneratorNotFoundException is thrown.

        Parameters:
        componentName - the component name
        Returns:
        the found component
        Throws:
        GeneratorNotFoundException - If no associated component could be found for the passed componentName.
